comparison_to_prior_banks: Any prior11/24 outcome uses different documents/models/context; descriptive historical result only, not a paired improvement claim.
exposure_retirement: Any selected source input projection retires all8fixeddocs as projectDEV forever, including failed attempts; 245→253 exposed,24reserved unchanged,154→146unreserved,total423
gold_protocol: Auditor validates fixed ordered24inputs/rawcaseidentities and all72finite3way logits/probabilities plus complete execution and owned-process closure before first selected annotation choice access. Then join only 24 predetermined choices. No class-based redraw or candidate changes.
isolation: Complete public annotated source JSON loaded in builder and auditor RAM; no labels projected by builder. Logical field access control only, never OS enforced label isolation.
matched_controls: Same frozen classifier/tokenizer/softmax/context budget and source input; nativeRuVector/RRF/BGE versus lexical versus positional retrieval; exact literal premise, selected spans, UTF8 byte hashes, discarded numerical literals and unknown/overflow paths retained in raw

metrics.Brier: mean sum of three class squared errors
metrics.NLL: mean -ln(max(p_gold,1e-12)); clipping count disclosed; probability vector not silently normalized
metrics.accuracy: case count and every original class count/correct plus fullconfusion and perdocument outcomes
metrics.errors: All raw errors/attempts/counters retained. Partial/missing outputs have no complete-corpus metric or gold projection and remain failed.
metrics.latency: p50/p95 linear interpolation at(n−1)*p; report reader forward distinct from retrieval/context/init and wholeworker
metrics.sampling: 8document groups ×3correlated hypotheses; no IID24case confidence interval

model_lineage: Official card says unknown supervised dataset; training/evaluation/selection/calibration identities and training-data licenses unresolved. Base checkpoint training revision unpinned. Unknown pretrained/fuzzy/supervised overlap retained.
new_data_claim: Project-unused DEV only, never independent heldout generalization or benchmark acceptance
permanent_benchmark_gate: benchmark_accepted=false/champion_promoted=false/official_SOTA_established=false regardless descriptive result; unresolved model lineage means CONF=[] HOLD and no reserved consumption
probability: Frozen uncalibrated unit-temperature softmax; native argmax tie order E,N,C; no fitting, threshold adjustment or retraining
selection: Metadata-only once; never redraw or rebalance after source, class, difficulty, length, runtime or performance findings
